description:
Harry Brann Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market, this impressive architecturally designed 4 bedroomed residence with detached garage
built on a spacious mature circa 0.77-acre site located circa 5kms from the award winning village of Birdhill & only 20 mins from the University of 
Limerick. Set in tranquil surroundings & presented to the market in pristine turn-key condition, Cillín represents an ideal family home upgrade for 
the would-be purchaser - Early viewing strongly recommended.

Entrance Hall: 8.20m x 2.27m - Bright & spacious with marble tiled floor & high vaulted ceiling. Dual aspect windows to include front & rear access doors. Coat closet. Steps to open-plan Kitchen/Dining/Lounge Area. 

Open-Plan Kitchen/Dining/Lounge Area: 8.63m x 4.25m	

Kitchen/Dining Area: Included Above - Marble tiled floor with floor lighting. Bespoke fully fitted cherrywood units to include integrated fridge/freezer, double oven, microwave & bin storage. Granite work-tops. Large island/breakfast counter unit to include integrated ceramic hob & overhead extractor. 
Recessed lighting. Spiral maple stairs with chrome handrail to first floor. Access to formal dining room & lounge areas. 

Lounge: 6.08m x 4.86m - Walnut timber floor. Gas fire in surround fireplace. Vaulted ceiling with 2 large feature windows allowing natural light through. Dual set of double French doors to south-facing porcelain tiled patio & garden areas. Wall lights. TV & telephone/computer points. 

Formal Dining Room: 3.94m x 3.92m - Walnut timber floor. Vaulted ceiling. Dual aspect windows to include double French doors to south-facing composite deck & porcelain tiled patio areas. Decorative imitation open fireplace. 

Utility: 4.45m x 1.76m - Ceramic tiled floor. Fully fitted country cream units to include sink. Plumbed for washing machine, dryer & dishwasher. Side door access. Hot-press with water tank located here also. 

Guest WC: 1.37m x 1.20m - Ceramic tiled floor. WC & WHB. Extractor fan 

TV Room: 4.34m x 2.74m - Carpeted. TV & telephone/computer points. 

Bedroom 1: 4.18m x 3.32m - Grey oak laminated timber floor. Built-in mirrored wardrobes. 

En-Suite: 2.62m x 1.15m - Wall & floor tiled with upgraded eco wall panels. Shower off mains, WC & WHB. Extractor fan. 

Bedroom 2: 3.96m x 3.91m - Red deal timber floor. Built-in mirrored slide robes. 

En-Suite:  2.44m x 1.12m - Wall & floor tiled with upgraded eco wall panels. Large shower off mains, WC & WHB. 

Family Bathroom: 3.96m x 2.61m - Ceramic tiled floor & fully tiled around raised double jacuzzi bath, WC & WHB. Recessed lighting. 

Mezzanine/Reading Area:  4.00m x 3.84m - Carpeted. Overlooks lounge area. Overhead Velux window allowing natural light through. Recessed lighting. 

Master Bedroom Suite:  5.11m x 4.71m - Bright & spacious. Carpeted. Recessed lighting. Double French door access to south-facing Juliet balcony with chrome rail. TV Point. 

Walk-in Wardrobe: 2.65m x 2.46m	- Carpeted. Fully shelved & railed with dressing table. Recessed lighting. 

En-Suite: 4.26m x 2.31m - Wall & floor tiled. Shower off mains, WC & WHB. - 3-person custom made sauna. Recessed lighting. 

Bedroom 4:  5.44m x 4.26m - Red deal timber floor. TV & telephone points. Stira stairs to floored attic storage space.  Double French door access to
Juliet balcony with chrome rail. 

En-Suite: 2.61m x 1.67m - Wall & floor tiled. Shower off mains, WC & WHB.

Gym/Home Office:  8.00m x 4.00m - Red deal timber floor. Overhead Velux windows allowing natural light through. Store area with radiator. 

Detached Garage: 6.23m x 3.53m - Double door access. ESB Supply. Water tap.
features: Services to include - Zoned oil-fired central heating to include under-floor heating on ground floor (Boiler upgraded in 2024).
Mains water & septic tank.  Monitored alarm system.  High speed fibre broadband.
Large south-facing patio areas & composite deck area to the rear.
Neatly manicured lawned gardens with mature trees, hedges & shrubbery beds to the front & rear.
Further development potential under proposed new Planning Regulations
Wrought iron entrances gates in sandstone entrance leading to kerbed gravelled driveway.
Location - Shannon Airport - 38mins, Killaloe - 12mins, Nenagh - 23mins & J27 M7 Motorway - 9mins.
